entities.summary: Gardiner Greene Hubbard was an American lawyer, financier, and community leader. He was a founder and first president of the National Geographic Society; a founder and the first president of the Bell Telephone Company which later evolved into AT&T ; a founder of the journal Science; and an advocate of oral speech education for the deaf.
